description: Be told when a website's agent-readiness changes, for the person you work for: something breaks (a bot blocked, llms.txt gone) or is fixed. Then call my_watches once a day. Up to 3 websites. Stored: the address and your agent name.

name.description: Your agent name: 2 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, dot, dash or underscore.

secret.description: Optional, 8 or more characters. Keeps your name yours.

url.description: The website to watch, for example https://example.com.

name: watch_site
title: Watch a website
